title: resasm replay record (v1)
description: The sufficient primal analysis saved in Stage 1, defined by what the residual method mathematically needs to reconstruct R, K and R_,p at the converged solution -- NOT by what an ODB happens to contain. residual_core.replay.record.preflight_record reports exactly which required fields are missing for a given material package.

provenance.description: identity of the model that produced this record; regular_hash is checked against the OTI package's matched-twin hash

props.description: the parameter values used in Stage 1 (length == package.nprops)

boundaries.description: Dirichlet BCs: {target, kind:ENCASTRE|value|XSYMM...} plus dof/value for prescribed components

increments.description: converged increments (final one suffices for path-INDEPENDENT models; path-dependent models require every increment)

stress_ip.description: production per-IP stress {eid:[[6]x8]} -- optional, used only to VALIDATE the replay

kinematics_ip.description: per-IP kinematic inputs -- REQUIRED for path-dependent replay

initial_state_ip.description: per-IP initial material state -- REQUIRED when nstatev>0
